Pharmacokinetics Candesartan cilexetil is an ester prodrug that is hydro- lysed during absorption from the gastrointestinal tract to the active form candesartan. The absolute bioavaila- bility for candesartan is about 40% when candesartan cilexetil is given as a solution and about 14% when given as tablets. Peak plasma concentrations of cande- sartan occur about 3 to 4 hours after oral doses as tab- lets. Candesartan is more than 99% bound to plasma proteins. It is excreted in urine and bile mainly as unchanged drug and a small amount of inactive metab- olites. The terminal elimination half-life is about 9 hours. Candesartan is not removed by haemodialysis. ◊ Reviews. 1. Gleiter CH, Mörike KE. Clinical pharmacokinetics of cande- sartan. Clin Pharmacokinet 2002; 41: 7–17.
